worldcombat.skill.xscissor.summary: Cross both scythes like a pair of scissors: the left blade sweeps one half of the arc and the right blade follows on the other half, so a target on the axis is settled twice and the strike point crosses into an X. The closed form focuses the axis and carries a second-blade bonus; the open form covers wider for a shorter cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.xscissor.description.0: Each blade deals %1$s contact damage to the foes it sweeps.
worldcombat.skill.xscissor.description.1: The two blades close in front of you, left then right: together they sweep an arc of about %1$s degrees, with about %2$s between the blades; a target on the axis is settled once by each blade.
worldcombat.skill.xscissor.description.2: In the closed form the second blade deals %1$s extra damage to a target the first blade already cut.
worldcombat.skill.xscissor.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.xscissor.growth.0: From level %1$s each blade rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.xscissor.growth.1: From level %1$s the closing reach extends to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.xscissor.use.0: Close two blades into a pair of scissors
worldcombat.skill.xscissor.use.1: Frame a target on the axis and cut it fully
worldcombat.skill.xscissor.use.2: Two beats, two sides, twice on the axis
worldcombat.skill.xscissor.preference.sc: On (closed): the opening tightens to 86 degrees and the second blade carries a bonus against a target the first already cut, at +1 wind-up tick and +4 cooldown ticks. Off (open): the opening widens to 128 degrees with a shorter wind-up and cooldown, at the cost of the second-blade bonus.
worldcombat.skill.xscissor.preference.ai: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of cutting. Larger values open with the cross from further out.
On: with two or more enemies in range it cuts first, treating the move as a way to trim a line. Off: it always prefers the current threat.
